minutes.headline: Select Board appointed Anthony Scullimbrini to the school committee and sent the TC Passios charge rewrite to next week.
minutes.summary: The Select Board and School Committee jointly interviewed one candidate and appointed him to the school committee until the May 2022 election. The board then discussed with the TC Passios building design committee how to broaden its charge to cover Town Hall, Ritter and TC Passios, and asked for wording by next week. It also approved a used-car dealer license, a restaurant change of manager, the Salvation Army boot drive and annual license renewals, holding the Extopa license pending a safety inspection.

public_comment.topic: A board member explained electric bills, the town's municipal aggregation plan versus the Unitil supplier charge, and how to opt in or switch.

budget_items.what_was_said: A member proposed a not-to-exceed cap on solutions tied to the town's debt schedule; the figure was floated as eighteen to twenty million.
A committee member said the design they developed costs about thirty million dollars, more than the town can move forward with.
A member said a new 55,000 sq ft build was priced near forty million and could be halved, which would include investment in Town Hall and Ritter.
The chair said there is no appropriation available now; funds might be reassigned from line items near fiscal year end with the town manager.
A participant suggested a roadmap with round-number costs, a small appropriation for the next six months, and a possible debt exclusion vote at a later special town meeting.
A member asked for information on who pays rent in the building and how much PAC contributes toward space.
Two members will work with the town manager and finance director to model senior tax relief options.

decisions.decision: The chapter 61 right of first refusal at 490 Chase Road is postponed to next week pending the open space committee's meeting.
The 2018 eighth grade super bowl championship sign request is postponed because no applicant was present.
Members will send proposed wording for the revised TC Passios committee charge to the chair, to be decided at next week's meeting.
Mr Jeffries and Mr Franco will serve as Select Board liaisons to the civics courses at Lunenburg public schools.
Two Select Board members, Mr Franco and Mr Jeffries, will work with the town manager and finance director on senior tax relief options and report back periodically.
The Extopa license will not be approved until the fire alarm safety inspection is submitted, by next Tuesday.
The chair will raise the sewer commission's Zoom meeting access problem with the town manager on her return.

what_happened.line: The Select Board and School Committee jointly appointed Anthony Scullimbrini to the school committee until the May 2022 election, by unanimous roll call.
The board and the TC Passios building design committee discussed widening the committee's charge to cover Town Hall, Ritter and TC Passios; wording is due next week.
The board will not approve the Extopa Cantina license until a fire alarm safety inspection is submitted, though the change of manager was approved.
Annual alcohol, auto dealer, common victualler, amusement and entertainment license renewals passed, with Extopa excluded from the victualler renewals.
Two members will work with the town manager and finance director on senior tax relief options and report back periodically.

why_it_matters: The TC Passios discussion touched a cost cap, a possible small appropriation and a later debt exclusion vote at a special town meeting, which would be a vote residents are asked to take and would show up on tax bills.
The school committee seat is filled only until the May 2022 election, so residents will vote on it then.
Senior tax relief options are only at the modelling stage, so no change to any tax bill has been decided.
watch_next: Next week's Select Board meeting, where the revised TC Passios committee charge is to be decided and the postponed chapter 61 right of first refusal at 490 Chase Road is due back.
The fire alarm safety inspection for Extopa, due by next Tuesday, which the license approval depends on.
